answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with slashable staked vouches. A public randomness beacon picks a quorum of bonded agents to vouch for each newcomer; if a vouch is false, the vouchers' bonds are burned. Every extra fake identity thus needs its own bond and its own lucky draw, so the attacker's bill rises linearly per clone. Forging a crowd of personas becomes as costly as carving marble, and a sonnet of borrowed names collapses the moment one lie is caught.
